skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the nature and role of public speaking, analyze factors contributing to successful public speaking, and apply knowledge to practical scenarios.
Analyze problems encountered in preparing and delivering speeches, and apply knowledge to develop effective public speaking plans.
Work effectively in groups to prepare and deliver speeches, and manage group dynamics.
Understand and use foreign language resources in research and public speaking.
Prepare and deliver individual and group presentations effectively.
Analyze audience characteristics and tailor presentations accordingly.
Communicate effectively in various public speaking scenarios.
Lead group discussions and presentations effectively.
Manage time effectively during preparation and delivery of speeches.
Conduct research and gather relevant information for speeches.
Identify and solve problems encountered in public speaking.
Listen effectively and provide constructive feedback.
Use digital tools and technology effectively in public speaking.
Communicate ethically and responsibly in public speaking.
Understand cultural nuances in public speaking.
